notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Change Character / Barrel
notes.notes:
Hello,
I have updated the game! You can now change the playable character and barrel, plus I’ve fixed some bugs.

- Changing the character (or barrel) is easy: Go back to the main menu (leave the game), then select the character and barrel you want to play with. Click Play → Continue → You will now play with your newly selected character and barrel. Additionally, your previous character and barrel will no longer appear in the Continue details.

- Fixed an issue with the level time notification (bottom left corner). This did not affect your times on the leaderboards, but the notification incorrectly displayed milliseconds that started with zeros. For example, 1:10.008 was shown as 1:10.8. This has now been corrected, so you can enjoy a bug-free experience—at least, I hope so! :)

If you find any other bugs, feel free to report them on the community hub, Discord, X, or via email at daveid95@gmail.com. Thank you!
